items.html: And even though you will find in the words of our sages that Adam HaRishon was created from the dust of the Temple (Beit HaMikdash), the place of his atonement — this is not the lower Temple, but only the upper one, which is in the six last [Sefirot] of Yetzira, as above. And this is what is said in this discourse of the Zohar: "but from the dust of the upper Temple (Aphra de-Vei Mikdasha de-Ila'a)," etc., as we will explain, with God's help.
